summary: Sporting News article by Nick Brinkerhoff offering Week 15 NFL DFS lineup advice for FanDuel GPP tournaments (Sunday main slate, $60,000 budget) and for SuperDraft. It gives player picks with salaries and reasoning, including Stafford, White, Hall, Samuel, Nacua, Rice, Okonkwo, Reed and the Giants defense. It also explains SuperDraft's multiplier-based scoring and lists a SuperDraft lineup built around a Rams stack.
one_line: Sporting News's Week 15 2023 NFL DFS guide with FanDuel GPP lineup picks and a SuperDraft multiplier lineup, anchored by Rams stacks.
key_facts: FanDuel scoring highlighted: four-point passing TDs and half-point PPR; the lineup is for the Sunday main slate with a $60,000 budget.
QB Matthew Stafford (Rams vs. Commanders) is priced at $7,200; Washington is called a defense that can't slow anyone down and it traded away two of its best defenders at the deadline.

RB Rachaad White (Buccaneers @ Packers, $7,600) has eight straight games of at least double-digit fantasy performances, including three straight with at least 100 total yards, and Tampa has handed him the ball 60 times over that stretch.
RB Breece Hall (Jets @ Dolphins, $7,500) posted over 100 total yards against the Texans for the first time since Week 5 after the Jets 'took the handcuffs off' Zach Wilson.
WR Deebo Samuel (49ers @ Cardinals, $8,400) has back-to-back games with 30 fantasy points and has been on a tear since Thanksgiving.
WR Puka Nacua (Rams vs. Commanders, $8,000) costs $200 less than Cooper Kupp; he is no longer seeing 15-20 targets a game but gets seven-plus per game.
WR Rashee Rice (Chiefs @ Patriots, $6,500) has been targeted 29 times over the past three games and scored twice; New England is expected to try to take away Travis Kelce.
TE Chig Okonkwo (Titans vs. Texans, $5,000) had 45 and 62 yards in Weeks 12 and 13 on 11 targets, and is missing only a touchdown; he catches passes from rookie QB Will Levis.
FLEX WR Jayden Reed (Packers vs. Buccaneers, $6,100) is recommended whether or not Christian Watson (hamstring) plays; Jordan Love 'appears to have turned a corner'.
DEF New York Giants (@ Saints, $3,500) is chosen because the Saints' offense is struggling and Derek Carr is playing through injuries.
SuperDraft uses point multipliers instead of salary caps; scoring is half-point PPR, four-point passing TDs, and two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards, and 300 passing yards.
SuperDraft lineup: Stafford (1.3x), White (1.2x), Bijan Robinson (1.25x), Nacua (1.25x), Samuel (1.2x), Rice (1.35x), Tyler Conklin (1.7x), and Derrick Henry at FLEX (1.2x).
The article promotes a SuperDraft offer: a free $10 deposit with promo code "TSN".
